topic: the withheld total must be withheld in the header too
lesson: The refusal state is inconsistent: when foots is false the footer and the alert say the total is withheld, but drill-panel.tsx:85 still renders the clicked Actual unconditionally in the panel's most prominent slot, the header <strong>. The panel therefore shows the very number it just said it cannot vouch for, in the largest type on screen - which is worse than either showing it plainly or withholding it plainly. Withhold it in the HEADER too when foots is false: replace the figure with the same withheld treatment the footer uses, keep the node title, the block heading and the line count (those are still true), and keep the leaf rows visible. One clear state, per constitution/07-exception-handling.md. Extend the existing refusal test to assert the header no longer shows the clicked figure.
